text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details; the family history of joint swelling and bleeding in your uncle raises concern for a hereditary clotting disorder. Given the severity of the post-extraction bleeding and bruising, have you ever experienced prolonged bleeding from cuts or had any spontaneous joint bleeds yourself?
